stories.title: Monorepo, Compose, and contracts skeleton
stories.goal: Create the pnpm workspace, empty package folders, Postgres/Redis/Traefik Compose, and the contracts package with frozen types from PLAN.md so every later story has a place to land.
contractChanges: Add Stack, IntentKind, SessionEventName, FileMap, Intent, AgentJob, AgentResult, SessionEvent, RuntimeStatus as Zod + TS types
Export actorId stub constant DEV_USER = "dev-user"
acceptance: pnpm-workspace.yaml lists apps/* and packages/*
packages/contracts builds and exports the frozen types from PLAN.md
infra/docker-compose.yml starts Postgres, Redis, and Traefik
apps/web and apps/api exist as stub packages that depend on contracts
pnpm install succeeds at repo root
nonGoals: No real UI beyond a blank Vite app

stories.title: Parent prompt shell
stories.goal: Build the parent app prompt box that POSTs to /sessions and shows a stub event log so the API and iframe can be wired in P1-S4.
contractChanges: Add CreateSessionRequest { prompt: string } and CreateSessionResponse { sessionId: string }
acceptance: Prompt textarea and submit button exist
Submit calls POST /sessions with CreateSessionRequest
A visible event-log area can render SessionEvent objects (may be empty until P1-S4)
Types imported from @terrarium/contracts only

stories.title: Isolated Docker sandbox runner
stories.goal: Start and stop a fixture app in Docker with resource limits and a unique preview URL. No agents.
contractChanges: Add SandboxHandle { sessionId, previewUrl, containerId }
Add HealthReport { status: RuntimeStatus, logs: string }
acceptance: Can start a fixture React app container for a sessionId
CPU, memory, PID, and network limits are applied
Returns a Traefik preview URL of the form {sessionId}.sandbox.local (or configured host)
Health check returns running or unhealthy with logs
Stop removes the container
Generated code never runs on the API host

stories.title: Session API, SSE, and stub worker
stories.goal: Create a session, enqueue a job, stream SessionEvents over SSE, and set the parent iframe when preview.ready fires. Worker is an echo stub (no LLM).
contractChanges: Document POST /sessions and GET /sessions/:id/events (SSE of SessionEvent)
acceptance: POST /sessions returns sessionId and enqueues a BullMQ job
Stub worker writes a fixture FileMap, starts sandbox, emits sandbox.ready then preview.ready
SSE stream delivers those events
Parent UI sets iframe src to previewUrl on preview.ready
No LLM calls

stories.title: Intent Agent
stories.goal: Classify the prompt as new vs modify and react vs fullstack, optionally attach toolId, and emit intent.classified.
contractChanges: Intent type is already frozen; add IntentAgentInput/Output aliases if needed without changing fields
acceptance: Given a prompt, returns Intent { kind, stack, summary, toolId? }
Modify requires an existing session/tool FileMap or toolId
API persists intent.classified on the session SSE stream
Does not write files or start Docker

stories.title: Code Generator Agent
stories.goal: Fill packages/templates/{stack} from Intent and return a FileMap for the sandbox. New apps only.
contractChanges: None beyond AgentJob / AgentResult already frozen
acceptance: templates/react and templates/fullstack exist as runnable starters
Generator returns FileMap derived from the matching template
Emits codegen.started and codegen.completed
API hands FileMap to sandbox (does not call Docker from the agent)
kind=modify is rejected; caller must use Editor

stories.title: Editor Agent
stories.goal: Apply targeted file edits for follow-up prompts without rewriting the whole app.
contractChanges: None
acceptance: Input includes existing FileMap + prompt
Output FileMap changes only files required by the prompt
Emits editor.started and editor.completed
kind=new is rejected; caller must use Code Generator
Does not call Docker

stories.title: Self-Healing Agent (max 3)
stories.goal: On sandbox.unhealthy, attach logs, route back through Intent to Editor or Code Generator, retry at most 3 times, then emit heal.exhausted.
contractChanges: Add healAttempt: number on AgentJob.errorContext or session state (0–3)
acceptance: sandbox.unhealthy triggers healer with logs
Each retry emits heal.attempt with the attempt number
After 3 failed retries, emit heal.exhausted and stop looping
Successful retry continues to preview.ready
No silent infinite loops
nonGoals: No changing max retries via UI

stories.title: Split-screen chat and iframe
stories.goal: Chat on the left, live tool iframe on the right (desktop). Stack vertically on small screens.
contractChanges: None
acceptance: Desktop: two-pane layout chat | iframe
Narrow viewport: chat above iframe
Iframe src is only the sandbox previewUrl
Empty state shown when no preview yet

stories.title: Stream agent steps into chat
stories.goal: Render SessionEvents and sandbox logs in the chat from SSE. No polling.
contractChanges: None
acceptance: EventSource (or fetch SSE) on GET /sessions/:id/events
Each SessionEvent appears in chat in order
No setInterval polling of session status
Reconnect on drop without duplicating the whole history incorrectly

stories.title: Live iframe refresh after edits
stories.goal: When editor.completed or preview.ready fires, refresh the iframe without reloading the parent page.
contractChanges: None
acceptance: On preview.ready, iframe src updates (cache-bust query allowed)
On editor.completed followed by preview.ready, iframe shows new content
Parent chat state is not wiped on refresh
nonGoals: No in-iframe HMR protocol of our own if sandbox Vite HMR already works — either is acceptable if the user sees the update

stories.title: Healing retry UX
stories.goal: Show retry n/3 while healing. On heal.exhausted, show the error and a Retry anyway action that starts a new attempt without changing the default max of 3.
contractChanges: None
acceptance: heal.attempt renders Retry 1/3, 2/3, or 3/3
heal.exhausted shows error logs in chat
Retry anyway posts a new session message / job; default auto max remains 3
Healthy preview still uses the iframe path
nonGoals: Do not raise the automatic retry cap

stories.title: Tool, version, and session schema
stories.goal: Add Prisma models for Tool, ToolVersion, and Session in Postgres, with types exported from contracts.
contractChanges: Add Tool, ToolVersion, Session DTOs (id, ownerId, status, createdAt, file snapshot metadata)
acceptance: Prisma schema migrated on Postgres from Compose
Tool, ToolVersion, Session tables exist
DTOs live in packages/contracts
API can create a Session row when POST /sessions runs

stories.title: Publish to personal workspace
stories.goal: Snapshot the current FileMap as a ToolVersion and list published tools for the actor (dev-user until Phase 6).
contractChanges: Add PublishToolRequest and ToolSummary
acceptance: Publish action stores FileMap as a new ToolVersion
GET workspace tools returns ToolSummary list for the actor
Opening a published tool can load FileMap into a session
nonGoals: No Smart Match index (P5-S1) beyond storing summary text if cheap

stories.title: Idle sleep and wake
stories.goal: Stop sandbox containers after inactivity and wake them when the user opens the tool. Status is sleeping or running.
contractChanges: RuntimeStatus already includes sleeping; ensure ToolSummary.status uses it
acceptance: Configurable idle timeout stops the container
Open/wake starts the container and returns previewUrl
Status exposed as sleeping | running | stopped
Sleep does not delete ToolVersion files

stories.title: Workspace dashboard
stories.goal: List the actor's tools with status, last version, and open (wake + preview).
contractChanges: None if ToolSummary already has status and updatedAt
acceptance: Dashboard lists published tools
Each row shows sleeping|running and last published time
Open wakes if needed and navigates to split-screen with preview

stories.title: Published-tool library index
stories.goal: Index each published tool (prompt, summary, stack) for later exact-problem matching.
contractChanges: Add ToolIndexRecord { toolId, stack, summary, promptFingerprint or embedding ref }
acceptance: Publish writes or updates an index record
Index can be queried by prompt + stack
Implementation may be embeddings or a deterministic fingerprint — pick one and document it in contracts comments

stories.title: Smart Match pre-check
stories.goal: After the user prompt, before Code Generator, scan the library and emit smartmatch.hit or smartmatch.miss.
contractChanges: Add SmartMatchResult { hit: boolean, toolId?: string, score?: number }
acceptance: Runs immediately after prompt, before codegen.started
hit emits smartmatch.hit with toolId
miss emits smartmatch.miss and pipeline continues to Intent/CodeGen
Does not start Code Generator on hit until the user chooses
nonGoals: No auto-load of the matched tool (P5-S4)

stories.title: Use existing vs build new
stories.goal: When smartmatch.hit fires, show the existing tool and let the user choose Use existing or Build new. Never auto-overwrite intent.
contractChanges: None
acceptance: Hit shows tool summary and two actions
Build new continues to Code Generator
Use existing is posted back to the API
No automatic navigation without a click
nonGoals: No permission checks beyond current actor (P6)

stories.title: Accepted match loads Editor path
stories.goal: If the user accepts a match, load that tool's FileMap into the sandbox (Editor path) and skip Code Generator.
contractChanges: Add AcceptMatchRequest { sessionId, toolId }
acceptance: Accepting a match does not emit codegen.started
FileMap from the published version is loaded
Sandbox boots and preview.ready fires
Further prompts use Editor (kind=modify, toolId set)
nonGoals: No fork/copy permissions beyond owner until P6

stories.title: Accounts and login
stories.goal: Replace dev-user with real signup/login and a session cookie or JWT.
contractChanges: Add User { id, email }, AuthSession, LoginRequest, SignupRequest
Remove DEV_USER from production path; keep only as test fallback
acceptance: Signup and login work
Authenticated requests carry user id
POST /sessions uses the logged-in user, not dev-user
Logout clears the session

stories.title: Ownership and roles
stories.goal: Every tool has an owner. Roles are owner, editor, viewer.
contractChanges: Add ToolMember { toolId, userId, role: ToolRole }
acceptance: Publisher is owner
Role enum is owner | editor | viewer only
Queries can list members for a tool

stories.title: Share with teammates
stories.goal: Owner can invite a teammate by email or user id and list members.
contractChanges: Add ShareToolRequest { emailOrUserId, role }
acceptance: Owner can add a member with editor or viewer
Members list is visible to owner and editors
Non-owners cannot change membership

stories.title: Enforce API and preview access
stories.goal: API and sandbox preview URLs require authorization. Unauthenticated iframe access is denied. Viewer cannot edit; editor can.
contractChanges: None required if roles already exist; add ErrorCode FORBIDDEN if missing
acceptance: Unauthenticated GET preview URL returns 401/403, not the app
Viewer can open preview, cannot POST edits
Editor and owner can POST edits
Non-members cannot load the tool from dashboard or API
